metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds eight shillings received, and a meeting set for Monday.

yesterday: Eight shillings, received. The share is entered as received.
They meet Monday and see what Monday is.
The yard is dry tinder. Margery has stood that stair nine years. Tomorrow is Sunday.
The second iron is on the chests. The licensed books go with John. Garnish carries the parts. The July roads were asked.
